question: At which Olympics did Gagan Narang win a bronze medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**London 2012**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Gagan Narang, an Indian shooter, won a bronze medal in the 2012 London Olympics in the men's 10m Air Rifle event.
 
• The final took place on August 2, 2012
 
• Gagan Narang finished with a score of **701.1** in the qualification and final rounds combined, securing third place.
 
• This was India’s **first shooting medal** at the London 2012 Olympics and Narang’s **first Olympic medal**.
 
• Narang’s performance was remarkable, as he had to compete against some of the world’s top shooters.
 
• The gold medal went to **Alin George Moldoveanu** of Romania, and the silver went to **Hao Zhang** of China.
 
• Before this Olympic achievement, Narang had already built a strong reputation, having won several international titles, including gold medals at the **Commonwealth Games** and **Asian Games**.
